title: Plugin MCP server config (.mcp.json, mcp.json)
description: The mcpServers file a Claude Code plugin (.mcp.json) or a Cursor plugin (mcp.json) reads from its root. Ours, because the agent-plugins.org MCP schema (https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/mcp.schema.json) requires a $schema member and "type": "stdio", which neither client's documented form carries, so it is not vendored here.
